# InviteSummary

What an invite is for, shown to the person accepting it before they register.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | The invite's id. |
| `code` | `string` | The invitation code the invite was sent with. |
| `emailAddress` | `string` | The e-mail address the invite was sent to. |
| `isInviteToTenant` | `boolean` | Whether the invite joins an existing tenant (true) or registers a new one (false). |
| `tenantName` | `string \| null` | The name of the tenant the invite joins; null for an invite to register a new tenant. |

## Example

```json
{
  "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "code": "...",
  "emailAddress": "...",
  "isInviteToTenant": false,
  "tenantName": "..."
}
```
